#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
typedef long long ll;
const ll MOD = 1000000007;

ll modPow(ll base, ll exp) {
    ll result = 1;
    base %= MOD;
    for (int i = 30; i >= 0; --i) {
        result = (result * result) % MOD;
        if (exp & (1LL << i)) {
            result = (result * base) % MOD;
        }
    }
    return result;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    
    ll p, k;
    cin >> p >> k;
    
    if (k == 1) {
        cout << modPow(p, p) << '\n';
        return 0;
    }
    
    vector<bool> visited(p, false);
    ll cycleCount = 0;
    
    for (ll i = 1; i < p; ++i) {
        if (!visited[i]) {
            visited[i] = true;
            cycleCount++;
            ll current = (i * k) % p;
            while (!visited[current]) {
                visited[current] = true;
                current = (current * k) % p;
            }
        }
    }
    
    cout << modPow(p, cycleCount) << '\n';
    return 0;
}
